title: Constrained Black-Box Attacks Against Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2508.09275v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Collaborative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is increasingly deployed in critical domains, yet its vulnerability to adversarial perturbations has not been thoroughly investigated. Most existing adversarial attacks against MARL rely on optimistic assumptions, such as access to policy weights or the ability to train surrogate policies. We investigate whether adversaries with limited capabilities remain effective against MARL agents. In particular, we study two restricted attack settings that are overlooked in the literature: (i) adversaries with access only to agent observations and (ii) adversaries with no access whatsoever. Our approach generates perturbations that intentionally misalign how victim agents perceive their environment, preventing them from collaborating. We conduct extensive experiments across a diverse set of 22 environments. Our results demonstrate both the effectiveness and sample efficiency of our attacks

translated_title: 针对协作式多智能体强化学习的受限黑盒攻击
translated_abstract: 协作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）越来越多地被部署在关键领域，然而其对对抗性扰动的脆弱性尚未得到充分研究。大多数现有的针对MARL的对抗攻击依赖于乐观的假设，例如能够访问策略权重或能够训练代理策略。我们研究了能力受限的攻击者是否仍然能够有效攻击MARL智能体。特别是，我们研究了文献中被忽视的两种受限攻击设置：（i）攻击者仅能访问智能体的观测；（ii）攻击者完全无法访问任何信息。我们的方法生成的扰动会故意使受害智能体对环境的感知产生错位，从而阻止它们进行协作。我们在22个多样化的环境中进行了广泛的实验。我们的结果证明了我们攻击方法的有效性和样本效率。
tldr: 该论文提出了两种此前被忽视的受限黑盒攻击设置（仅能访问智能体观测或完全无法访问任何信息），通过生成使智能体环境感知错位的扰动来有效破坏协作式多智能体强化学习，且无需访问策略权重或训练代理策略，在22个环境中验证了攻击的有效性和样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two overlooked constrained black-box attack settings—access only to agent observations or no access at all—that effectively disrupt cooperative MARL by generating perturbations that misalign how victim agents perceive their environment, without requiring policy weights or surrogate policy training, demonstrating effectiveness and sample efficiency across 22 diverse environments.
